citations.quote: 通过可转债名称基本可以知道对应的正股，可交债多数情况也可以判断可以交 换的股票，毕竟多数情况可交债是由大股东发行，发行方和对应标的股票关联很 大。
‚缺钱的时候拿现釐，不缺钱的时候拿股权‛，或者捡一种表述， 即‚股权值钱的时候留股权，股权不值钱的时候选现釐‛。

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: A 可转债 (CB) converts into the issuer's own newly-issued shares (an equity issuance in disguise); a 可交债 (EB) exchanges for the issuer's HOLDING of another company's already-existing shares (a stake the issuer pledges). 攻守 captures the intuition as '牛市都一样, 熊市大不同' — bull-market behaviour similar (both ride underlying toward strong-call), bear-market diverges sharply via 下修-willingness asymmetry.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: China Convertible Bond — 可转债 vs 可交债 (CB vs EB) Comparison
